lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: par dhan par naaree rat ni(n)daa bikh khaaee dukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Caught in slander and attachment to the wealth and women of others, they eat poison and suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਭੈ ਕਪਟ ਨ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad cheen bhai kapat na chhoote man mukh maaiaa maaiaa ||
lines.translation: They think about the Shabad, but they are not released from their fear and fraud; the minds and mouths are filled with Maya, Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਗਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ajagar bhaar lade at bhaaree mar janame janam gavaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Loading the heavy and crushing load, they die, only to be reborn, and waste their lives again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bhaavai sabad suhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Shabad is so very beautiful; it is pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bhram jon bhekh bahu keenhe gur raakhe sach paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The mortal wanders lost in reincarnation, wearing various robes and clothes; when he is saved and protected by the Guru, then he finds the Truth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਨੑਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath tej nivaar na nhaate har kaa naam na bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He does not try to wash away his angry passions by bathing at sacred shrines. He does not love the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਜਤ ਕੋ ਤਤ ਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan padaarath parahar tiaagiaa jat ko tat hee aaiaa ||
lines.translation: He abandons and discards the priceless jewel, and he goes back from where he came.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੀਟ ਭਏ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisataa keet bhae ut hee te ut hee maahi samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: And so he becomes a maggot in manure, and in that, he is absorbed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਕ ਸੁਆਦ ਰੋਗ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: adhik suaad rog adhikaaee bin gur sahaj na paaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: The more he tastes, the more he is diseased; without the Guru, there is no peace and poise. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਰਹਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa surat rahas gun gaavaa guramukh giaan beechaaraa ||
lines.translation: Focusing my awareness on selfless service, I joyfully sing His Praises. As Gurmukh, I contemplate spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਾਦੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojee upajai baadee binasai hau bal bal gur karataaraa ||
lines.translation: The seeker comes forth, and the debater dies down; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru, the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਹੋੁਤੇ ਹੀਣਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਤੂ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham neech houte heenamat jhoothe too sabad savaaranahaaraa ||
lines.translation: I am low and wretched, with shallow and false understanding; You embellish and exalt me through the Word of Your Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਿ ਤਹਾ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਣ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aatam cheen tahaa too taaran sach taare taaranahaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: And wherever there is self-realization, You are there; O True Lord Savior, You save us and carry us across. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਕਥਉ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bais suthaan kahaa(n) gun tere kiaa kiaa kathau apaaraa ||
lines.translation: Where should I sit to chant Your Praises; which of Your Infinite Praises should I chant?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਥਾਂ ਨਾਥਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: alakh na lakheeai agam ajonee too(n) naathaa(n) naathanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Unknown cannot be known; O Inaccessible, Unborn Lord God, You are the Lord and Master of masters.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਉ ਤੂ ਕੈਸਾ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚਕ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis pahi dekh kahau too kaisaa sabh jaachak too daataaraa ||
lines.translation: How can I compare You to anyone else I see? All are beggars - You are the Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatiheen naanak dar dekhahu ik naam milai ur dhaaraa ||4||3||
lines.translation: Lacking devotion, Nanak looks to Your Door; please bless him with Your One Name, that he may enshrine it in his heart. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Malaar, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸਾ ਬਿਲਖ ਬਦਨ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin dhan pir kaa saad na jaaniaa saa bilakh badan kumalaanee ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride who has not known delight with her Husband Lord, shall weep and wail with a wretched face.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhaee niraasee karam kee phaasee bin gur bharam bhulaanee ||1||
lines.translation: She becomes hopeless, caught in the noose of her own karma; without the Guru, she wanders deluded by doubt. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baras ghanaa meraa pir ghar aaiaa ||
lines.translation: So rain down, O clouds. My Husband Lord has come home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਾਂ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bal jaavaa(n) gur apane preetam jin har prabh aan milaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has led me to meet my Lord God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉਤਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nautan preet sadaa thaakur siu anadin bhagat suhaavee ||
lines.translation: My love, my Lord and Master is forever fresh; I am embellished with devotional worship night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mukat bhae gur daras dikhaaiaa jug jug bhagat subhaavee ||2||
lines.translation: I am liberated, gazing on the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Devotional worship has made me glorious and exalted throughout the ages. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜਗੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham thaare tribhavan jag tumaraa too meraa hau teraa ||
lines.translation: I am Yours; the three worlds are Yours as well. You are mine, and I am Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai nira(n)jan paaiaa bahur na bhavajal pheraa ||3||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, I have found the Immaculate Lord; I shall not be consigned to this terrifying world-ocean ever again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਿਰ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: apune pir har dekh vigaasee tau dhan saach seegaaro ||
lines.translation: If the soul-bride is filled with delight on seeing her Husband Lord, then her decorations are true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਸਚਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: akul nira(n)jan siu sach saachee guramat naam adhaaro ||4||
lines.translation: With the Immaculate Celestial Lord, she becomes the truest of the true. Following the Guru's Teachings, she leans on the Support of the Naam. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਈ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੑੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat bhaee ba(n)dhan gur kholhe sabad surat pat paaee ||
lines.translation: She is liberated; the Guru has untied her bonds. Focusing her awareness on the Shabad, she attains honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam rid a(n)tar guramukh mel milaaee ||5||4||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is deep within her heart; as Gurmukh, she is united in His Union. ||5||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਮਲਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 1 malaar ||
lines.translation: First Mehl, Malaar:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਰ ਲੋਭਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: par daaraa par dhan par lobhaa haumai bikhai bikaar ||
lines.translation: Others' wives, others' wealth, greed, egotism, corruption and poison;

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਭਾਉ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dusat bhaau taj ni(n)d paraaee kaam krodh cha(n)daar ||1||
lines.translation: evil passions, slander of others, sexual desire and anger - give up all these. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahal mahi baithe agam apaar ||
lines.translation: The Inaccessible, Infinite Lord is sitting in His Mansion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਆਚਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bheetar a(n)mrit soee jan paavai jis gur kaa sabad ratan aachaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: That humble being, whose conduct is in harmony with the jewel of the Guru's Shabad, obtains the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
